# Viewer libraries

- Google model-viewer 4.4.0: `model-viewer.min.js`, distributed through the official `@google/model-viewer` npm package. Apache-2.0 license: `model-viewer-LICENSE.txt`. Source: https://github.com/google/model-viewer
- Google Draco 1.5.7: `draco/draco_wasm_wrapper.js` and `draco/draco_decoder.wasm`. Apache-2.0. Official browser decoder distribution: https://www.gstatic.com/draco/versioned/decoders/1.5.7/ — source: https://github.com/google/draco

The viewer and decoder are served locally. Geometry conversion utilities are not included in this website.
